data.gender_notes: Biswa is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Biswa originates from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'extensive', 'expansive', or 'wide'. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of several gods and goddesses, symbolizing the vastness and limitlessness of the universe. The name Biswa carries the meaning “Expansive, extensive, wide” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Biswa usually hope their child will grow to embody expansive, extensive, wide and live with faith, good character and purpose.
